title: Can Cheesecake Factory Sustain Its 15.2% Comps Surge Into 2027?
summary: Can CAKE turn a 15.2% comps surge into lasting growth? Strong traffic and rewards momentum face tougher 2027 comparisons and a test of repeat visits.

title: Darden Just Raised Its Dividend 8%. Is Olive Garden Still a Retirement Staple?
summary: Darden's payout outpaces inflation, yet shareholder returns now outrun the cash the restaurants generate. Retirees counting on that quarterly check should see which lever management can pull first, and which warning sign could show up at the next earnings report.
